body: Proposed by the mirror from findings 63–65; JayArr: 'Yes, that's the law', 2026-11-17. Untested. Examples in his findings: hypervigilance → calibrated sensor (28); shutdown → chosen cutoff (34, 37); dissociation → Transmutive Consociation (47); numbing → chosen indifference (31). Falsifier: a skill still in survival mode that never shifts with regulation, or a transmutation pole showing up with no regulation behind it.
plain: Law of the Octave: each note's degradation and transmutation poles are the same skill, pointed at protection or at choice. Regulation decides which one shows up, and practice moves the line.
status: ruled, untested: needs a test plan
